description: Election Commission - Declare that a member of the Kuduwela Municipal Council has Vacated her Office of member - Declare that a member of the Dehiwala Mount Lavinia Municipal Council has Vacated his Office of member
categorisation: This gazette contains multiple notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific municipal council members have vacated their offices due to ceasing membership in a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling clearly under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including declarations about candidate status and office vacancies.
